node.websocket.request.name: WebSocket request
node.websocket.request.description: Open one connection on the selected interface, optionally send a message and receive one reply. No automatic replay.
node.websocket.listen.name: WebSocket listener
node.websocket.listen.description: Receive text and binary messages across bounded concurrent connections. Reply with a fixed value or a downstream reply node.
node.websocket.reply.name: WebSocket reply
node.websocket.reply.description: Send one response on the original connection and source peer using the received request handle.
